register.labelZh: WRITE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: write back 可以表示回覆某人;write in 和 write off for something 則可用來表示聯絡節目、公司或其他機構。；write down 可以表示記下重要資料;write out 和 write up 則可以把簡短筆記或符號整理成完整文字、文章或報告。；你可以把角色寫進故事、把規則寫進協議,也可以把某人從電視劇集中刪除。；write somebody off 可以表示過早斷定某人沒有希望;write something off 和 write somebody up則可以描述正式的財務或紀律行動。
register.summaryEn: Write back helps you reply to someone, while write in and write off for something help you contact programmes, companies and other organisations. Write down helps you record important information. Write out and write up help you turn short notes or symbols into complete words, articles or reports. You can write a character into a story, write a rule into an agreement or write someone out of a television series. Write somebody off can show that someone has been judged too quickly. Write something off and write somebody up can describe formal financial or disciplinary actions.
